layoutMeta.title: speech2speech
layoutMeta.description: One conversation in two languages on one device. Speak, translate, read aloud.

footer.machineNotice: The translation comes from a language model and can be wrong. Ask again when something matters.
footer.selfHosted: Runs on your own server. Audio and text only go to the model you configured.

access.title: Access
access.intro: This page is protected by a password.
access.label: Access password
access.offline: The server is not answering right now.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.intro: Two languages, one conversation. Speak or type into your field, the translation runs alongside. Everything stays in the history.
conversation.hint: Both speak or type in turns, each side in its own language.
conversation.noTranslationModel: No chat model is configured, so nothing is translated. Set LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL.
conversation.noSpeechModel: No speech recognition model is configured, so the microphone stays quiet. Typing still works. Set STT_MODEL.

limits.near: This conversation is nearly full and will end by itself. Start a new conversation to carry on.
limits.full: This conversation is full and has ended. It stays readable, start a new conversation for new sentences.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: What this installation can do, and the one switch this page has.

models.translationMissing: Not configured. Set LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL.
models.ttsMissing: Not configured. Set TTS_MODEL and TTS_VOICE.

settings.readAloudHint: Shows a button next to every translation that reads it aloud.
settings.privacy: Audio and text only go to the models you configured. The browser's own speech recognition is not used.

protocol.title: Conversation transcript
protocol.intro: Both languages in the order of the conversation.
protocol.empty: No conversation yet, there is nothing to record.

saved.title: Past conversations
saved.intro: Every conversation you start is saved. Open one to read it again or to continue.
saved.rule: The last {max} conversations are kept. When a new one starts, the one untouched longest drops out.
saved.full: {max} of {max} conversations. The next new conversation deletes the bottom entry of this list.
